messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm putting together the new runtime cost + SLO dashboard for Dedicated and Hosted. Need alignment on alerting thresholds and pager routing before I wire panels. Goal: avoid noisy pages for transient KV-cache spikes. Thoughts?

samir: +1. We should base alerts on 1) SLO burn rate (24h rolling), 2) sustained p95/p99 tail latency over a 5-15m window, and 3) sustained error rate + increased fallback rate. Also include cache_hit_ratio metric.

lee: To avoid noise, prefer burn-rate based paging. Example: trigger pager when 24h burn rate > 1.5 for 2 consecutive evaluation windows (30m). For latency, use service-level rule that pages only if p99 > 1.5x SLO for 10m and request_count > X.

asha: important: make sure alerts suppress during release rollouts. Can we wire a tag from the rollout system? If deploy-bot labels a rollout as 'canary' we should silence certain pages for 30m.

maria: yeah we can. Samir/Lee, can you sign off on a concrete rule set I can paste into the dashboard? I'll add runbook links.

samir: rough rules below — can refine:

```
# SLO burn pager rule
if slo_burn_24h > 1.5 for 2 windows (each 15m) -> page oncall

# Latency noisy-rule
if p99_latency > slo_threshold*1.5 AND request_rate > 50rps for 10m -> page
else if p99_latency spike but request_rate < 50rps -> create ticket only

# Cache degradation
if kv_cache_hit_ratio < 0.7 for 10m and fallback_rate > 0.05 -> page
```

lee: +1. Also add suppression key when rollout_tag=="canary" OR maintenance_window==true. And route pages to runtime-oncall for Hosted/Dedicated primary, then to infra if infrastructure error codes are in the payload.

jonah: how will we detect infra vs app? We need the alert payload to include 'failure_class' from telemetry: infra | model_degraded | routing_congestion | auth. If telemetry doesn't have it we should add a delta.

maria: telemetry team: do we have failure_class? @samir can you confirm?

samir: we emit error_type but not normalized failure_class. I'll add a mapping in the collector (takes 2-3 days) to set failure_class. I can also emit rollout_tag and cache_hit_ratio for older runtimes.

asha: for pager routing, prefer escalation path: runtime-oncall -> eng-platform -> eng-sre. We'll include a richer payload so routing rules can be automated in PagerDuty. Also, add a suppression boolean in the alert so the pager integration can avoid paging when maintenance or rollout.

maria: Action items:
- samir to add failure_class + rollout_tag + cache_hit_ratio to telemetry (ETA 3 days) @samir
- lee to author dashboard panels + draft alert rules in grafana (ETA EOD Thu) @lee
- jonah to update PagerDuty mapping to route by failure_class (ETA 2 days) @jonah
- asha to add runbook and escalation steps to the alert templates (ETA Fri) @asha

deploy-bot: Deployment started: telemetry-collector v3.2.1 -> staging

lee: noted deploy-bot — I'll hold off on final paging rules until collector rollout is in staging.

maria: thanks everyone. I'll create the dashboard PR and link the draft alert rules. If no objections by Friday I'll merge and schedule a 1-hour burn-in with reduced alert sensitivity 24h after merge :thumbsup:

samir: fine with that. Suggest we add a temporary 'no-page' flag for first 24h post-merge to let us tune thresholds.

asha: agreed. We'll monitor and escalate if burn rate climbs unexpectedly.

jonah: I'll also add a test alert (non-paging) to verify PD routing once failure_class is in telemetry.

maria: perfect — closing here. I'll ping in #eng-oncall when the PR is up.
